speed-to-lead.title: Answer inbound leads in minutes
speed-to-lead.label: Speed to lead
speed-to-lead.summary: Reach every new signup the same day, enriched and in your CRM.
speed-to-lead.prompt: Make sure we reach every new signup the same day: add each one to the CRM, enrich it within a credit cap I set, and queue it for outreach.
trigger_phrases: New signups sit for days before anyone reaches out
Route my inbound leads into the CRM automatically
Answer trial signups the same day they arrive
Set up speed-to-lead for my demo requests
Enrich and follow up on form fills without me watching

pilot.check: Run one made-up signup through the table and read its company, fit score, CRM person and credits used before switching on the automatic lookup.

speed-to-lead.business_case: A new signup is most likely to answer in the first hours. Catch every signup in one table, look up the company and score the fit under a cap you set, add the person to your CRM, and reply to the best ones the same day.
speed-to-lead.outcome: A signup address your form posts to, each signup looked up and scored on arrival under a per-signup cap, a morning step that adds new signups to the CRM and lists the best fits, and a follow-up email ready to start.
speed-to-lead.leading_metric: hours from signup to first personal reply, and replies from same-day contacts
speed-to-lead.benchmark: Replying within hours rather than days is widely held to lift replies (estimate; measure your own). Measured in the audit: about 1 credit for the company lookup and 0.075 for the fit score per work-email signup; a personal email skips the lookup.

effort.time_to_value: first test signup looked up, scored and in the CRM in one session

credits.pilot: 1-3 (one test signup: company lookup plus fit score)
credits.full: about 1.1 per work-email signup (at most 2.1), capped at 5 per delivery; CRM link and emails cost 0

prerequisites.detail: Company, offer and ICP saved, so the fit score matches who you sell to
Contact lists (CRM people) exist; Step 1 creates them
Something that can send each signup as JSON to a web address: your app's backend, or a form tool through Zapier or Make
Only for the automatic follow-up email: a connected mailbox (an own mailbox costs 100 credits a month)
